title: Check-In Call Cadence
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=checkin:call
| stats max(_time) as last_call by contact
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_call)/86400,1)
| where days_since>3
| sort - days_since
description: Tracks how long it has been since each family member last checked in on a loved one and nudges when the gap grows.
value: Sharing the caring load is easier when everyone can see who last called and who is overdue.
implementation: Ingest check-in calls into `index=personal`; flag contacts who have not called recently.
visualization: Table of contacts with days since last check-in.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps track of when each family member last rang, so someone always checks in and nobody is forgotten.
